posts.title: The necessity of trust
posts.description: Success requires trust—there’s no way around it. “If you want something done, do it yourself”, some say. There’s wisdom in this; nobody’s ever going to care about your business (or you) as much as their own; that’s just honest. posts.title: Theory will get you only so far
posts.description: Theory will only take you so far. The quote is from the movie Oppenheimer; they’re discusing experimental vs. theoretical physics, and how sometimes, theory misses the mark. Entrepreneurship is the same way. It isn’t called “theoretical business” but may as well be—margins, markets, competition, required rates of return.
